parsed.notes: The Credit Facility leverage ratio is a debt-to-capitalization measure: it must not exceed 60%, and the actual was 0.01. It is not a debt/EBITDA multiple, so it is classified as 'other'. The interest coverage test is an alternative: the company must meet either the 1.5x minimum coverage or a minimum liquidity amount. The Credit Facility also has non-ratio covenants, which are not listed above: minimum Consolidated Tangible Net Worth of at least $2,201.2M (actual $3,080.0M) and a cap on Investments in Unrestricted Subsidiaries/JVs of at most $924.0M (actual $9.5M). The MIF Mortgage Repurchase Facility is M/I Financial's mortgage warehouse repurchase facility, not a bank credit agreement, so its covenants are excluded. Its leverage ratio limit is at most 12.0 to 1.0, with an actual of 6.74 to 1.0, and it also has liquidity, adjusted net income and tangible net worth tests.
